pages.text: Altered from $(5)Lure$(), $(4)Gravity Well$() has a much higher chance of pulling in a catch, but also gives a chance for an implosion upon trying to reel it in, which will instead pull in any entities near the hook, including the user. Maximum level is $(4)III$() and it conflicts with $(5)Lure$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: It does lower the delay between catches more than Lure would, but makes it nearly impossible to have a relaxing fishing session. It can often cause the user to meet face to face with a dangerous creature that also got pulled in.
